label: Whatever is not INFINITE_1 has a non-maximal degree of act
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred. For every x: if x is not INFINITE_1, x's degree of act is not the greatest on the degree scale (not IsTop). After ST I q.7 a.2: what has received being is limited. Weakest form: it is met as soon as some degree is not at most x's act, even an incomparable one; 'something strictly exceeds it' (not IsMax) would be stronger and closer to 'limited'. Together with 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 has a maximal degree of act' it makes being INFINITE_1 equivalent to having the greatest degree of act, close to a degree reading of DEF-INFINITE; the warrant load of the account lies mainly on the knowability, knowing-within-act and COMPREHEND sense-bridge premises. Equivalently (contrapositive, classically): whatever has a maximal degree of act is INFINITE_1. It applies to every being, intellects included, and to an intellect raised by the light of glory, which q.12 a.7 calls created and finite. Needed: without it, a non-INFINITE_1 intellect COMPREHEND_2s an INFINITE_1 being in a model of the other three premises (Control part 4).
